versions.content: No Third-Party XML Namespaces The only valid XML names- paces that are allowed in AUTOSAR XML descriptions are: • the AUTOSAR XML namespace (http://autosar.org/schema/r<major>.<minor>) [TPS_ASR_00017] and 12 of 26  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 779: AUTOSAR_TPS_ARXMLSerializationRules ARXML Serialization Rules AUTOSAR CP R19-11 • the XML Schema Instance namespace (http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema- instance) No other Third-Party XML namespaces are allowed.
